data.one_liner: Button that shows a progress indicator while awaiting async work.
data.what_it_does: AwaitableButton widgets replace normal buttons when an async operation is triggered. They automatically display an indicator, prevent double taps, and expose callbacks for completion or error handling.
use_when: Need to prevent multiple taps during async work
Want a quick loading indicator on a button
Need error handling callbacks on button press
avoid_when: You need a fully custom animation or state machine beyond a simple loading indicator
You are building a complex form that requires more advanced state management
strengths: Easy to integrate, no extra dependencies
Customizable indicator, color, size, and executing child
weaknesses: Only works with Flutter, not web-only widgets
Limited to simple async patterns, no stream support
